items.title: [Virtual Event] Shields Up: Key Technologies Reshaping Cybersecurity Defenses
Chinese cyberspies breach Singapore's four largest telcos
items.description: The Chinese threat actor tracked as UNC3886 breached Singapore's four largest telecommunication service providers, Singtel, StarHub, M1, and Simba, at least once last year. [...]

items.title: Warlock Gang Breaches SmarterTools Via SmarterMail Bugs
items.description: The ransomware group breached SmarterTools through a vulnerability in the company's own SmarterMail product.

items.title: TeamPCP Turns Cloud Infrastructure into Crime Bots
items.description: The threat actor has been compromising cloud environments at scale with automated worm-like attacks on exposed services and interfaces.
